blocked_reason: KripVerify sandboxed `next dev` server was unable to compile and serve `/` within 25+ minutes of CPU time at 20% utilization. Multiple `kv_navigate` / `kv_verify` calls returned IPC timeouts after 10s, with the underlying next-server process never completing the initial route compile. Restarting the sandbox (kv_restart_dev_server) produced a fresh listener on a new port but the same hung-compile behavior recurred. This is an infrastructure-level issue with KripVerify-local for this large editor bundle (Three.js + R3F + drei + many editor surfaces); production verification gates passed cleanly.
